meta.title: Session N4 cross-workbook reconciliation - what every published workbook actually recommends
meta.method: Recommendation text extracted programmatically from each workbook's executive-summary/decision pages on the merged tree at ab596f9, then read line by line. Each row links to the workbook page it came from. These are the workbooks' own published claims - not independently re-verified facts.

rows.recommendation: Hybrid: extend 5 years now at a reset rent, keep a 2030-2035 sale window; decision turns on achievable reinvestment yield
rows.breakeven_stated: 6.97% reinvestment breakeven; hold if appraised cap > 7.00%

rows.recommendation: Sell now via 1031 ranks first on risk-adjusted certainty equivalent; 'extend then sell' second; renew-and-hold ranks last
rows.breakeven_stated: scores per $1 NOI index (A1 11.79 vs C 3.96)

rows.recommendation: Two-stage: 90-day blend-and-extend inquiry now, then sell into a 1031 exchange while >=6 years of term remain; never hold passively into the final 3-4 years
rows.breakeven_stated: 6.0-year financing cliff; extension compressing exit cap >=50bp thesis

rows.recommendation: Time-boxed 60-day blend-and-extend probe (>=97% rent, >=2.0% annual steps), then 1031 sale at 6.45%-6.60% cap with 10+ year WALT
Sequenced plan: get lease + insurance, get appraisal, open extension conversation trading term for rent reset, then choose hold vs exchange against two observable numbers
Extend first; if the tenant will not extend on acceptable terms, sell now through the same exchange; downside bounded by the sale, not the lease
rows.breakeven_stated: not stated as a single number in the summary

rows.recommendation: Plan is 'extend, then price' rather than either endpoint; trade term for a fair-market reset and a guaranty, then sell the re-priced asset into a deeper buyer pool
rows.breakeven_stated: beats selling whenever replacement yield is below its breakeven

rows.recommendation: HOLD with renewal is the expected-value winner only while renewal terms are strong (escalators >= metro ECI 3.9%) and tenant credit holds; dual framing against the reinvestment benchmark
rows.breakeven_stated: asset yield ~6.8% vs verified 4.86% reinvestment rate (as published)

rows.recommendation: Dual track from today: approach tenant/brand for a 10-15 year extension at or above in-place rent AND prepare a 1031 exit; sell in 2028 if no extension by 31 Dec 2027
rows.breakeven_stated: extend-then-sell beats sell-now across -100bp..+100bp cap shifts in its table

rows.recommendation: Confidential 90-day blend-and-extend inquiry now, then a 2027-2028 pre-cliff sale and 1031 exchange into 2-3 diversified net-lease assets
rows.breakeven_stated: not stated as a single number in the summary

rows.recommendation: Negotiate an early renewal/extension now - target >=10 years with CPI-banded escalations - then either hold the enhanced stream or sell at a higher price on the longer term
rows.breakeven_stated: not stated as a single number in the summary

rows.recommendation: Dual track: extension proposal + sale pricing in parallel; sell into 1031 only if cap <=6.00% or replacement yield clears 6.97%; hold/extend if cap >7.00%
Sequence: extend, then sell; fallback sell 2027-2028 with >=5 years of term via 1031 if tenant will not extend by mid-2027
rows.breakeven_stated: 2% rent growth + tight caps => extend-and-sell; 3%+ => extend-and-hold

rows.recommendation: Ranks 'extend, then sell' above 'extend and hold'; renewal branch treated as deterministic, no renewal probability assigned
rows.breakeven_stated: scenario scores (extend-then-sell 2738.31 vs extend-and-hold 2891.03 at its base)

rows.recommendation: Dual track, time-boxed: extension inquiry now (>=10y term at or above in-place rent) + parallel 1031 sale prep; never drift into the final 3-4 years unmanaged
rows.breakeven_stated: 7.81% exit-cap and 8.64% reinvest-yield breakevens at n=7 (assumption basis)

agree: A passive hold into the final years before expiry is the worst managed outcome - every workbook rejects it.
Opening an extension / blend-and-extend conversation now is recommended by every workbook that states a sequence.
A Section 1031 sale is the preferred exit vehicle over a taxable sale wherever a replacement pipeline exists.
The owner-private facts (rent, expiry, options, basis) are missing everywhere and gate any property-specific number.
disagree: The single breakeven number: 6.52% (session-313ba936) vs 6.97% (root, session-d9c94ed0) vs ~6.8% asset-yield framing (session-5f296f9d) vs 7.81% exit-cap / 8.64% reinvest (this session). Different assumption sets, not different data - flagged as IR-09.
Whether renew-and-hold can ever win: session-5f296f9d says yes on expected value with strong terms; session-313ba936's ranking and docs/ put renew-and-hold last.
convergence.reading: The qualitative decision is robust across fifteen independent analyses: extend first, keep the sale ready, never drift to expiry unmanaged. The quantitative triggers must be re-solved against this owner's actual rent, expiry and appraisal before any irreversible move.
